## Website change monitor with screenshots

On a schedule, fetch a page, detect whether its content changed since the last run, and capture a full-page **PolyDoc screenshot only when it did** (a lightweight HTML poll guards the heavier screenshot, so you do not spend a screenshot on every run). The snapshot is emailed as a PNG.

**Flow**
1. Schedule trigger (every 6 hours by default)
2. Settings holds the URL to watch (edit it in one place)
3. Fetch page pulls the HTML
4. Detect change hashes the normalized HTML and compares it to the last run (stored in workflow static data)
5. Changed? routes to the screenshot branch only on a real change
6. PolyDoc captures the page, then it is emailed as a PNG

**Setup**
1. Set the **url** in the *Settings* node.
2. Add your **PolyDoc API** credential on the *Screenshot page* node (key from dashboard.polydoc.tech).
3. Add an **SMTP** credential on *Email screenshot*, or delete that node and connect Slack / S3 / Google Drive instead.

The change state persists between **scheduled** runs. A manual test always counts as a first run (changed), so you can see the screenshot branch immediately.

Start free: https://polydoc.tech/?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=screenshot
